name: BMW S1000RR
engine: 999 cc liquid-cooled inline four, fuel injected
intro: BMW's superbike. Several recalls, from 2012 connecting rod bolts to a 2026 ignition lock recall on 2020-on bikes.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2012 bikes are in recall 12V177 (connecting rod bolts). Some 2020 bikes are in recall 20V146 (brake light). 2022 bikes are in recall 22V752 (clutch cover bolts). Some 2023 bikes are in recall 23V123 (brake lever). 2020-2026 bikes are in recall 26V478 (ignition lock can fail and stall the engine).
A-002.reason: A loose rod bolt or a stall at speed is serious. Every fix is free.

recalls.what: Emergency stop signal can make the brake light flash instead of staying on.
recalls.fix: Dealer reprograms the emergency stop signal free.

recalls.what: Clutch cover bolts were not lubricated, so the cover can loosen and leak oil.
Hand brake lever problem can reduce braking.
Ignition lock may fail and stall the engine.
